components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action on the waybill; reaches a live-goods anchor or a real state change.
components.html: READ THE FULL GOODS LIST
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 24px; background: #c2410c; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a63609; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Link
components.description: A quiet in-page action printed as an underlined mono label.
components.css: .ds-link-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: #1b2a52; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(27, 42, 82, 0.4); text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-link-secondary:hover { color: #c2410c; } .ds-link-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: A pill-shaped department filter with a live line count.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #b9aa90; border-radius: 999px; color: #1b2a52; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-chip span { color: #c2410c; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #1b2a52; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip Active
components.description: The inverted state of the department filter.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; background: #1b2a52; border: 1px solid #1b2a52; border-radius: 999px; color: #f3ead8; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active span { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c2410c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Waybill Panel
components.description: A rounded paper panel carrying live-read status or cost fields.
components.css: .ds-waybill-panel { background: #fffcf4; border: 1px solid #b9aa90; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; color: #1b2a52; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-waybill-panel dl { margin: 0; } .ds-waybill-panel dl > div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #b9aa90; } .ds-waybill-panel dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Delivery Stamp
components.description: The signature double-rule stamp that states the payment promise; its container is unbordered so the stamp is the only card in that column.
components.css: .ds-delivery-stamp { width: max-content; background: #fffcf4; border: 4px double #c2410c; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px; color: #c2410c; transform: rotate(-3deg); text-align: center; animation: ds-stamp-press 620ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-delivery-stamp span { font-family: 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; font-size: 30px; line-height: 0.95; letter-spacing: -0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-stamp-press { from { transform: rotate(-1deg) scale(1.015); } to { transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-delivery-stamp { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The storefront reads as a printed waybill: goods, costs, and payment printed with bureaucratic clarity on warm kraft paper. It replaces the previous editorial field-guide world rather than polishing it. Metaphor never sits in front of merchandise; the live goods cards are the hero, and the cash-on-delivery stamp is the one memorable flourish.

The system is flat, ruled, and dense enough to be trusted. Fine muted rules form the grid, IBM Plex Mono carries every label and number, and burnt orange appears only where the visitor needs to act or where the payment promise is stamped. Product photography remains API-supplied; the homepage ships no local raster and invents no inventory or social proof.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft ground with carbon-copy separations and softly rounded paper panels.
One action color, used sparingly on primary buttons, live status, and the COD stamp.
Tabular mono data for prices, stock, categories, and costs.
Pill-shaped actions and chips inside a softly rounded paper-panel world.
Honest loading, empty, and failure states instead of placeholder goods.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Burnt orange is the only accent. If an element is not an action, a live-data signal, or the payment stamp, it does not get the accent.

rules.name: The Rule Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px muted rules, dashed carbon-copy separators, and tonal paper layers. The only heavy line is the double-rule cash-on-delivery stamp. No grain, rings, stripes, or gradient substitutes.

rules.name: The Mono Ledger Rule
rules.body: On the waybill, explanatory copy, product names, and every value that changes with live data are mono and tabular. Outfit belongs to the rest of the app, not to the printed form.

rules.name: The Flat Form Rule
rules.body: Panels sit on the page by tone and a hairline border. No ambient shadows, lifted cards, or glass effects belong on the waybill.

dos: Do read prices, stock, categories, and product names from the live API; show the honest failure state when the read fails.
Do keep primary buttons #c2410c in both themes; use #ff8a5b only as the dark-surface text and stamp tint.
Do use 1px muted rules, rounded panels, pill actions, and tabular IBM Plex Mono for live values.
Do keep all visible CTAs on working in-page anchors, built routes, honest placeholders, or real state changes, with targets at least 44px tall.
Do leave product photography to API-supplied URLs; this surface ships no local raster.
donts: Don't add testimonials, customer counts, delivery dates, returns promises, benchmark numbers, or sample inventory.
Don't link to /products or /products/:id while those paths remain unbuilt, and don't present the cart placeholder as a working checkout.
Don't use grain, concentric rings, repeating stripes, gradients, italic display, numbered section labels, or editorial object language on the waybill.
Don't use Newsreader display type on this surface; it remains only for the untouched auth screens.
Don't hide goods behind hover, carousels, or decorative panels; the live goods cards are the hero.
